answer: Vendor terms of OpenAI (Terms of Use Effective 2026-01-01, Wayback 20260823021834), Anthropic (Consumer Terms Effective 2025-10-08; Commercial Terms Effective 2025-06-17), Google Gemini API Additional Terms (Effective 2026-03-23), and GitHub Terms of Service Section J (Effective 2026-04-27) assign or disclaim ownership of Output to the user and do not prescribe a C2PA or SPDX marketplace schema. OpenAI additionally prohibits representing Output as human-generated when it was not; that is the load-bearing listing-disclosure duty from terms. EU Regulation 2024/1689 Art 50(2) requires machine-readable marking by providers of synthetic-content AI systems; Art 50(4) deployer disclosure is scoped to deepfakes and to public-interest informing text, not to software blueprints as such. US 88 FR 16190 requires disclosure on copyright registration applications. California AB 2013 / Civil Code 3111 is a GenAI-developer training-data website duty, not a blueprint-row duty. C2PA Content Credentials 2.3, SPDX 3.0.1 AIPackage, and CC Signals are proposed-norm. Marketplace metadata that must be added beyond today's lockfile (name, version, source_url, digest) is generation_method plus generation_disclosed_in_listing; ai_generated_extent is required-by-law-somewhere for later US registration. A2 _generated headers are registry-projection provenance and must not be reused as LLM provenance. Not legal advice. Owner sign-off is pending before downstream units may act.

obligation_table.document_version: OpenAI Terms of Use Effective: January 1, 2026
obligation_table.obligation: A listing of model-generated blueprints or presets must not represent the Output as human-generated when it was not.
obligation_table.overclaim_guard: The clause is a use-restriction, not a mandated C2PA/SPDX schema. It does require the marketplace not to label model Output as human-authored.
obligation_table.quote: Represent that Output was human-generated when it was not
obligation_table.scope_note: Live openai.com returned HTTP 403 this run (three URLs). Claim is pinned to the Wayback capture, not to an unversioned live HTML surface.

obligation_table.obligation: In the EU, providers of AI systems (including GPAI) that generate synthetic audio, image, video or text must mark outputs in a machine-readable format as artificially generated or manipulated, as far as technically feasible.
obligation_table.overclaim_guard: Art 50 does not name C2PA. Art 50(7) encourages codes of practice; treating C2PA as the legally required format would be overclaim.
obligation_table.quote: marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated
obligation_table.scope_note: This binds the model/system provider. A marketplace that only lists blueprints generated by someone else's model is not Art 50(2) by that listing alone.
obligation_table.who_is_bound: providers of those AI systems (not automatically a third-party marketplace)

obligation_table.obligation: EU deployers must disclose deepfake image/audio/video as artificially generated. Deployers of systems that generate or manipulate text published to inform the public on matters of public interest must disclose unless human review plus editorial responsibility applies.
obligation_table.overclaim_guard: Do not treat every marketplace blueprint listing as Art 50(4) text disclosure.
obligation_table.quote: Deployers of an AI system that generates or manipulates text which is published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated
obligation_table.scope_note: A software blueprint/preset is not a deepfake. The text-disclosure limb is for public-interest informing publications, not for code catalogs as such.
obligation_table.who_is_bound: deployers in the Art 50(4) fact patterns

obligation_table.obligation: US Copyright Office registration applicants must disclose more-than-de-minimis AI-generated content in the application and describe the human author's contribution.
obligation_table.overclaim_guard: Not a requirement to attach C2PA to every marketplace row.
obligation_table.quote: applicants have a duty to disclose the inclusion of AI-generated content in a work submitted for registration
obligation_table.scope_note: This is a registration-form duty, not a general publication or marketplace-posting mandate. Carrying generation_method on the listing makes a later registration truthful.
obligation_table.who_is_bound: copyright registration applicants in the United States

obligation_table.obligation: California Civil Code 3111 (AB 2013, Chapter 817) requires a developer of a generative AI system or service to post training-data documentation on the developer website on or before January 1, 2026 (and before each subsequent public release/substantial modification).
obligation_table.quote: the developer of the system or service shall post on the developer’s internet website documentation regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence system or service
obligation_table.scope_note: Applies to developers of the GenAI system, not to a marketplace listing of a blueprint generated by a third-party model.
obligation_table.who_is_bound: developers of GenAI systems/services publicly available to Californians

obligation_table.obligation: C2PA Content Credentials (a C2PA Manifest) can carry cryptographically bound assertions about origin, modifications, and use of AI, including digitalSourceType values such as trainedAlgorithmicMedia. Adopting C2PA on marketplace artifacts is a proposed interoperability method, not a term or a named legal exclusive format.
obligation_table.overclaim_guard: Proposed-norm by design. Catalog control requires at least one such row.
obligation_table.quote: Content Credentials, also known as a C2PA Manifest
obligation_table.scope_note: GitHub c2pa-org/specifications main at the named SHA. Spec 2.3 landing was fetched live; treating C2PA as legally required would be overclaim.
obligation_table.who_is_bound: implementers who choose to emit Content Credentials

obligation_table.obligation: SPDX 3.0.1 AI profile documents AI software packages (systems/models/datasets) including AIPackage and informationAboutTraining. Using it as marketplace metadata for a blueprint listing is a proposed SBOM/AI-BOM practice, not a vendor-term requirement.
obligation_table.overclaim_guard: Proposed-norm. Do not treat SPDX AIPackage as required listing metadata.
obligation_table.quote: The AI Profile is designed to provide a standardized way of documenting and sharing information about AI software packages
obligation_table.scope_note: AIPackage describes an AI application or trained model, not a workflow blueprint per se.
obligation_table.who_is_bound: implementers who choose SPDX 3 AI profile conformance
